# AL-Swati Contracting (شركة السواطي للمقاولات)

> Stone cladding contractor in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, since 1994. AL-Swati installs natural stone, marble, granite and large-format porcelain facades with Hilti and Fischer certified mechanical (dry) fixing, using its own direct workforce. Registered with the Saudi Contractors Authority (SCA), SASO-compliant materials, minimum 5-year written workmanship warranty.

Key facts (updated 24 November 2026):

- Founded: 1994 in Riyadh. More than 30 years of experience and more than 500 completed projects: villas, palaces, commercial towers, and government and institutional buildings.
- Workforce: 100% direct workforce. AL-Swati's own trained, Hilti- and Fischer-certified teams install every facade; installation is not subcontracted.
- Services: natural stone cladding (Riyadh stone, limestone, sandstone, granite), marble cladding, and large-format porcelain facades, for exterior facades and interior feature walls. AL-Swati does not do flooring, floor tiles or paving.
- Fixing systems: Up-Down angle brackets, PEN (pin) fixing, vertical C-Channel rails, kerf rail system and undercut anchors. Hilti and Fischer anchors; stainless steel grade 304 or 316 per the approved design; aluminium rails and sub-frames. No panel is bedded on cement mortar.
- Engineering: wind load is calculated for each project by AL-Swati's engineer to the Saudi Building Code SBC 301, which sets anchor type and spacing. Panel thickness: limestone and granite 30 mm, marble 20 mm, travertine and porcelain per design. CAD (.DWG) fixing details and method statements are available to consultants on request.
- Compliance and warranty: registered with the Saudi Contractors Authority (SCA); all materials comply with SASO specifications; minimum 5-year written workmanship warranty on every contract.
- 2026 price ranges in Riyadh (SAR per m², supply and installation on Up-Down brackets for a villa facade, excluding 15% VAT): Riyadh white stone 230-280, Riyadh limestone beige/yellow 290-375, granite 265-340, travertine and marble 505-700, large-format porcelain 265-340. C-Channel, kerf and undercut systems cost more; final prices follow a free site visit and a written quote.
- Service areas: all of Riyadh, including Al Malqa, Al Narjis, Hittin, Al Yasmin, Diriyah and Al Olaya, plus Dammam and Al-Ahsa.
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +966 51 182 6313, email info@al-swaticontracting.com, office 7663 Abi Al Thaka St, Al Malaz, Riyadh 12842-3667. Sunday to Thursday, 08:00-18:00.
